categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet spend and fee-bumping logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents replacement transactions created by bumpfee from receiving an older locktime than the original transaction, eliminating an on-chain fingerprint. Under anti-fee-sniping random backdating, an empirical study showed 200-300 replacement transactions per week (<2% of replacements) were backdated and fingerprintable as Bitcoin Core or Electrum (closes #26526).
